f3ff5368e9ab41cb.job_title: Community and General Entertainment Integration Manager
f3ff5368e9ab41cb.description: Community and General Entertainment Integration Manager | Gaming, Festivals & Live Events Location: Riyadh, Saudi Arabia / Remote with required travel Contract: 14 months, with potential 3-month extension Experience: Minimum 8 years Sector: Gaming, Esports, Festivals & Live Entertainment About the Opportunity We are recruiting an experienced Community and General Entertainment Integration Manager to support a major international gaming and esports festival programme in Saudi Arabia. This is an exciting opportunity for a live entertainment and festival programming professional with proven experience creating engaging community experiences, managing main-stage entertainment and delivering large-scale, multi-week event programmes. The successful candidate will be responsible for developing and coordinating entertainment activities across festival common areas, fan zones and community spaces, ensuring a varied and engaging visitor experience throughout the event. Key Responsibilities Plan and coordinate entertainment programming across festival common areas, main stages and community spaces. Develop multi-week entertainment calendars, including live performances, fan activities, community events and special programming. Create engaging experiences for diverse audiences, including gaming fans, families and general visitors. Design and manage rotating entertainment content to maintain audience engagement throughout the festival. Coordinate main-stage programming, weekly highlights and major entertainment moments. Develop practical programming plans covering audience capacity, visitor throughput, space requirements and staffing. Collaborate with event planning, production, venue operations and technical delivery teams. Manage programme schedules, content updates and live-event changes. Ensure entertainment activities align with wider festival programming and operational requirements. Essential Requirements Minimum 8 years' relevant experience in entertainment, community or festival programming for large-scale live events. Proven experience delivering at least two live event seasons . Demonstrated hands-on experience personally developing multi-week entertainment calendars, content rotations and main-stage programmes. Strong understanding of live entertainment, festival programming and audience engagement. Experience planning entertainment formats with consideration for audience capacity, staffing and venue space. Proven ability to coordinate multiple entertainment activities and stakeholders simultaneously. Excellent organisational, communication and problem-solving skills. Professional English communication skills. Desirable Experience Experience programming major gaming, esports, pop-culture or international entertainment festivals. Background in fan zones, community activations, family entertainment and interactive visitor experiences. Experience developing programmes involving international entertainment partners and diverse audiences. Previous experience working in Saudi Arabia or the wider GCC. Arabic or Japanese language skills. Working Arrangements Two potential working arrangements are available: Riyadh-based: Working from the project office, with relocation and visa support subject to agreed terms. Remote-based: Working Sunday to Thursday on Riyadh business hours, with required travel to Saudi Arabia. Candidates must be available onsite in Riyadh during the required festival operating periods in July–August and November 2027. This is a full-time, fixed-term engagement requiring dedicated involvement throughout the programme. How to Apply If you have a strong background in live entertainment programming, community engagement and major festival delivery, we would like to hear from you. Please apply with your updated CV and details of relevant festivals or entertainment programmes you have personally delivered. Candidates should be able to demonstrate previous multi-week programming experience, including main-stage schedules, entertainment calendars and live-event delivery.

f34b946b12a655be.job_title: Senior Manager - Cost Planning - Master Development (SPA4- 50007562)
f34b946b12a655be.description: Qiddiya Investment Company is looking for an experienced and analytical individual to join our team as Senior Manager - Cost Planning. This role play an essential part in our mission to establish a world-class entertainment destination in Saudi Arabia. You will be responsible for building up construction costs, devising and overseeing pre contract cost management strategies and ensuring that all financial aspects of our projects are aligned with the overall budget and strategic goals of the organization. Primary Responsibilities Cost Planning: Take a proactive approach to cost planning by understanding cost vs. value equation, ensuring optimal financial outcomes without compromising project goals Cost Consultant Management: Oversee the monthly tracker for scope and cost movements from previous phases and assist in reviewing cost plans submitted by Cost Consultants for accuracy and design alignment. Monitor and analyze design efficiencies as the project progresses, ensuring that the 3rd party Cost Consultant adheres to the defined scope of work, guidelines, and procedures. Standards: Ensure strict adherence to defined policies and processes, while maintaining a thorough understanding of IPMS measurement guidelines. Demonstrate familiarity with Qiddiya's established policies, processes, and templates. Business Units: Provide internal updates to your Business Unit on the status of construction costs and design metrics. Ensure representation during internal reviews to facilitate progress and successfully pass through Stage Gates. Benchmarking: Understanding of benchmarking to effectively integrate design metrics with cost positions, ensuring assurance throughout all phases of the project lifecycle. Feasibility: Awareness of feasibility requirements with regards to cost planning. 7+ years relevant Cost Planning Experience (Cost Planning, Quantity Surveying, Estimating) Local GCC Experience Worked in Local (GCC) Construction industry for 2 years or more (preferred) Expert with industry standards eg NRM, CESSM, RIBA, POMI, etc. Experience in working on large scale projects with Construction Value greater than: 200m SAR Familiar with benchmarking cost and design. Experience with costs/benchmarking in KSA or Middle East is preferable Basic ability to convey information. Limited experience in adapting messages for different audiences Strong Understanding: Proficient in using Cost Planning Software and aware of its application, CostX is preferable.

f38077adda891a7c.description: About the Role AECOM is seeking an experienced and detail-oriented Senior Quantity Surveyor to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role requires extensive expertise in quantity surveying, cost management, and project delivery to ensure successful project outcomes. The Senior Quantity Surveyor will work independently on complex assignments while providing strategic guidance and mentorship to junior team members. Key Responsibilities Conduct comprehensive surveys and measurements of natural features and human-made structures using advanced electronic distance-measuring equipment and surveying instruments. Operate and manage land-information computer systems, including data storage, system inquiries, and generation of detailed plots and reports. Review and analyze survey team information regarding distances, directions, angles, and elevation data to ensure accuracy. Research legal records and historical boundary documentation to identify previous boundaries and determine precise boundary lines. Record survey results meticulously, verify data accuracy, and prepare comprehensive plots, maps, and technical reports. Prepare detailed quantity takeoffs, cost estimates, and budget forecasts for construction projects, aligning with project scope and client requirements. Manage procurement processes, analyze tender documents, and negotiate contracts with suppliers and subcontractors. Mentor and supervise junior quantity surveyors and survey technicians, providing feedback and fostering professional development. Collaborate with project managers, architects, engineers, and clients to resolve discrepancies, manage variations, and maintain transparent communication. Analyze project performance data and prepare reports to support decision-making and continuous improvement. Stay current with industry standards, regulatory requirements, and emerging technologies in quantity surveying and construction management. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in quantity surveying and cost management. Demonstrated expertise in project delivery and managing complex assignments. Strong analytical mindset and collaborative approach. Ability to work independently and provide strategic guidance. Company Overview AECOM is a global infrastructure leader focused on delivering a better world. As a professional services firm with deep technical abilities, AECOM addresses complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation, and buildings. The company partners with public and private sector clients to create innovative, sustainable, and resilient solutions across the entire project lifecycle, from advisory and planning to design, engineering, and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm. Recruitment Process AECOM is committed to a secure and trustworthy recruitment process. All newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment. AECOM is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

f3b459ea14327100.description: About Kaspersky Kaspersky has been providing cybersecurity solutions to individuals and corporate clients globally for 27 years. The company serves 400 million unique users and 270,000 corporate clients, offering 517 products and holding 1100 technological patents. With 34 offices worldwide, Kaspersky's team comprises over 5,500 experts dedicated to protecting against cyber threats. The Role of Key Account Manager Kaspersky is seeking a Key Account Manager to join its team in Riyadh. This full-time role is responsible for developing, overseeing, and executing enterprise sales strategies. The position is central to establishing and maintaining long-term business relationships with customers and driving revenue growth within the assigned territory. Key Responsibilities Achieve quarterly and annual sales targets from enterprise accounts on the Named Accounts List (NAL). Establish and maintain executive-level relationships to build a qualified pipeline and drive revenue. Develop customer contacts into leads and manage the entire sales cycle. Articulate the value of Kaspersky's products and services to high-level stakeholders within customer organizations. Identify, develop, and articulate compelling value propositions to prospective large enterprise customers. Position specialized Kaspersky services, including cybersecurity training, threat intelligence services, and Anti-APT solutions, to large enterprises. Provide proposals and product information to prospects. Manage funnel reporting and updates using Salesforce. Collaborate with Partner Account Managers to ensure deal closure and full sales cycle support from appropriate resellers or system integrators. Independently drive the entire sales cycle for customer acquisition. Stay informed about the competitive landscape and the latest trends in the security market. Act as a trusted consultant for enterprise clients to position Kaspersky products and services as their preferred choice. Lead the process of timely responses to RFPs, in conjunction with partners and colleagues. Present the Kaspersky portfolio of products and services at field events such as conferences and seminars. Convey customer requirements to Product Management teams regularly. Coordinate with the Global Enterprise Sales Team. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's Degree in Marketing, Management, Business Administration, or an equivalent field. 5+ years of direct account management experience in IT Sales, specifically handling large accounts. A strong, documented track record of achieving sales quotas. Demonstrated history of delivering presentations to large corporations. Existing contacts and relationships at the CxO level within large accounts. 10+ years of experience in IT, with 5+ years in Cybersecurity considered an advantage. Work Environment This full-time position is based in Riyadh. The role involves working within a team of experts dedicated to protecting the world from cyber threats, collaborating with various internal and external stakeholders. Application Process Join Kaspersky to contribute your skills to a growing and evolving team. The salary for this position will be discussed during the interview process.

f3e245358dbc8121.description: About alfanar Group alfanar Group is seeking an HSE Officer to join their team in the Eastern Province. This full-time role is based in Riyadh and requires 2-5 years of experience. Preference will be given to candidates with Aramco approval. Role Purpose The HSE Officer will support the efficient promotion and implementation of Health, Safety, and Environment procedures. This role ensures adherence to defined policies and procedures, contributing to departmental operational plans and developments while maintaining quality standards. Key Responsibilities Perform planned activities to meet operational and development targets according to delivery schedules. Utilize resources effectively to achieve objectives within efficient cost and time parameters. Provide periodic reports detailing deviations and execution of planned tasks. Resolve operational problems and escalate complex issues as necessary. Ensure quality requirements are met, including developing effective quality control processes and specifications. Coordinate written systems, policies, and procedures, seeking automation opportunities. Comply with all related policies, procedures, and work instructions. Ensure compliance with relevant safety, quality, and environmental management procedures and controls within the defined work area. Core Duties Assist in developing, monitoring, and implementing the organization's health and safety policy. Ensure compliance with health and safety regulations to reduce or prevent hazards and accidents on site. Ensure policies and procedures are in place and enforced, maintaining legal requirements for health and safety in the workplace. Inspect workplaces for potential hazards, assess risks, and report findings. Conduct drills, such as fire drills, to ensure equipment functionality and staff emergency preparedness. Respond to and investigate accidents and emergencies. Demonstrate working knowledge of site-specific work rules (SABIC, SEC, MARAFIQ, ARAMCO, SWCC). Understand the principles of risk assessments and method statements. Manage all documentation required for access gate passes for workers across all sites. Fulfill and submit all regulatory documentation for site startup, in-process activities, and closing. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of experience in a relevant HSE role. Aramco approval is preferred. Work Type This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Eastern Province.

f3f1be01675bd381.description: About CodeNinja Inc. CodeNinja Inc. is a full-stack Sovereign AI delivery company that supports Saudi enterprises and government entities in building, owning, and compounding AI and engineering capabilities. Operating from Riyadh, the company provides delivery capabilities across the Kingdom and the broader MENA region, focusing on priority sectors such as government digitization, energy, financial services, logistics, and healthcare. CodeNinja Inc. is recognized among the 100 fastest-growing technology companies of 2026 by Clutch, partnering with banks and enterprises to modernize systems and operationalize intelligence across mission-critical workflows through embedded engineering teams, AI capability centers, and owned application infrastructure. The Role: Senior Appian Developer - Process & Workflow CodeNinja Inc. is seeking a Senior Appian Developer - Process & Workflow to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This is a contract, onsite role open to all nationalities. The successful candidate will be responsible for designing and building complex process models, case management flows, and business rules for Appian applications within a leading bank in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The role emphasizes performance, maintainability, and auditability of solutions. Key Responsibilities Build complex process models, including subprocesses, parallel flows, escalations, timers, exception handling, and multi-level approvals. Implement case management solutions for banking operations such as account opening, credit approvals, disputes, KYC refresh, and complaints. Model business rules and decisions using Appian expression rules and decision tables. Design task routing, SLAs, delegation, and maker-checker controls in alignment with segregation-of-duties policies. Optimize process performance, focusing on memory usage, process archiving, node counts, activity chaining, and smart-service choices. Implement audit trails and process history as required by compliance and internal audit standards. Write rule test cases and provide support for QA and UAT defect resolution. Review peer process designs and mentor mid-level developers. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in a relevant field. Strong hands-on Appian development experience. Demonstrated experience within a banking or financial services environment. Work Environment This is an onsite contract role based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The position involves working directly with a leading bank in the Kingdom, focusing on core banking workflows from account opening to credit approvals and end-to-end complex case management solutions.

f34015f84b1e2a1b.description: Sales Manager is responsible for leading and developing key account management activities nationwide, driving revenue growth, strengthening customer relationships, and expanding market share across key business sectors. The role oversees the performance and development of the national key accounts team, develops effective sales strategies, and ensures the achievement of business objectives, revenue targets, and customer satisfaction goals. Key Responsibilities Sales Strategy & Business Development Develop and implement national sales strategies to achieve revenue growth, customer acquisition, retention, and market expansion objectives. Identify and pursue new business opportunities across key industries and develop strategic relationships with major customers. Lead negotiations and close commercial agreements with large corporate clients. Drive upselling and cross-selling initiatives to maximize revenue from existing and new customers. Monitor market trends, competitor activities, customer demand, and industry developments to identify business opportunities and risks. Contribute to the development of annual budgets, revenue forecasts, sales targets, and business plans. Key Account Management Lead and manage national key account operations to ensure strong customer relationships and sustainable business growth. Develop tailored solutions that meet customer requirements and enhance service delivery. Promote the adoption of automated solutions and digital tools to improve customer experience and operational efficiency. Monitor account performance, identify improvement opportunities, and implement corrective actions where required. Maintain comprehensive customer and industry information to support account planning and commercial decision-making. Leadership & Team Management Lead, coach, and develop the key accounts team to achieve individual and departmental sales objectives. Establish performance targets, monitor KPIs, and provide regular performance feedback. Identify training and development needs and implement initiatives to improve sales capabilities and effectiveness. Develop workforce and manpower plans in line with business requirements. Support talent development, succession planning, and employee career progression. Performance Management & Reporting Monitor national and regional sales performance against approved targets and budgets. Prepare and present sales reports, forecasts, performance analyses, and strategic recommendations to senior management. Identify sales performance gaps and implement action plans to improve productivity and profitability. Ensure effective sales processes, compliance with company policies, and timely completion of reporting requirements. Participate in sales audits and lead continuous improvement initiatives. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Governance Collaborate with internal departments to support customer requirements, business development initiatives, and new projects. Evaluate business opportunities against company policies, commercial objectives, and operational capabilities. Support senior management in strategic projects and business initiatives. Ensure compliance with applicable company policies, procedures, and governance requirements. Promote workplace health, safety, environmental awareness, and business continuity practices within the department. Required Skills & Competencies Strong national sales strategy and business development capabilities. Advanced key account management and negotiation skills. Strong knowledge of sales processes, products, and commercial solutions. Excellent understanding of the Saudi market, regional territories, and competitive landscape. Proven leadership, team development, and performance management capabilities. Strong analytical, planning, organizational, and decision-making skills. Excellent relationship management, networking, and communication skills. Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and relevant business systems. Advanced English proficiency. Key Success Measures Achievement of national revenue and sales targets. Growth in key account revenue and market share. New customer acquisition and existing customer retention. Team productivity and achievement of individual sales KPIs. Customer satisfaction and quality of account management. Sales forecasting accuracy and budget performance. Successful implementation of business development initiatives. Qualifications & Experience Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Sales, Marketing, or a related field. A postgraduate qualification is an advantage. Minimum of 5 years of relevant professional experience , including at least 2 years in a managerial role , preferably within the logistics, courier, transportation, or freight forwarding industry. Alternatively, candidates with a diploma or relevant professional certifications may be considered with: Over 8 years of logistics, courier, or freight forwarding experience, including at least 3 years in senior management; or Over 10 years of relevant industry experience, including at least 5 years in management.

f34e36fda0a44330.description: About the Role Duncan & Ross is seeking an experienced Civil 3D Modeler – Dry Utilities to join major infrastructure projects in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves creating and coordinating BIM models for dry utility systems, ensuring compliance with established BIM standards and project requirements. Key Responsibilities Develop accurate 3D BIM models for dry utility networks using Autodesk Civil 3D. Prepare utility alignments, duct bank layouts, profiles, and construction drawings. Coordinate dry utility models with roads, structures, wet utilities, and landscape disciplines. Produce 2D drawings, shop drawings, and detailed BIM deliverables. Perform clash detection and model coordination activities using Navisworks or similar software. Support quantity extraction and preparation of utility coordination drawings. Ensure compliance with BIM Execution Plans (BEP), company standards, and project requirements. Update and revise BIM models during design and construction phases. Maintain proper documentation and records of BIM deliverables and coordination reports. Support engineering teams with technical drafting and modeling requirements. Project Scope The successful candidate will contribute to a range of significant projects, including infrastructure and utilities projects, smart city developments, road and transportation projects, and mega developments with mixed-use components. The role focuses on digital engineering within these projects. Required Experience Candidates should possess 3-5 years of experience in Civil 3D modeling, specifically with dry utility systems such as electrical, telecom, ICT, street lighting, and utility corridors. Work Location and Type This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

f37eadbf032218ec.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة ملاك المجوهرات عن بائع مجوهرات للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة الدمام. يهدف هذا الدور إلى تقديم تجربة تسوق مميزة للعملاء من خلال بيع المجوهرات وتوفير معلومات شاملة عنها، بالإضافة إلى إدارة عمليات الدفع والمخزون بكفاءة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية بيع مجموعة متنوعة من المجوهرات للعملاء. توفير معلومات دقيقة ومفصلة حول المجوهرات المعروضة وأسعارها. مراقبة مستويات المخزون بشكل دوري لضمان توفر المنتجات. الحفاظ على ترتيب المتجر ونظافته لتقديم بيئة تسوق جذابة. إصدار طلبات شراء المنتجات الجديدة عند الحاجة. التعامل مع المنتجات الواردة وترتيبها في المتجر. إتمام عمليات الدفع وتلقي المدفوعات من العملاء بدقة. معالجة طلبات استبدال المنتجات والمرتجعات وفقاً لسياسات الشركة المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المبيعات، ويفضل أن تكون في قطاع المجوهرات أو التجزئة. القدرة على التعامل مع العملاء وتقديم خدمة ممتازة. مهارات تواصل قوية ولباقة في التعامل. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق. نوع العمل هذا الدور متاح بنظام الدوام الكامل في مدينة الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. الراتب سيتم تحديد الراتب بعد المقابلة الشخصية، وهو غير معلن في الوقت الحالي. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم للنظر فيها.

f3894d2d52ac226a.description: About the Role Artas Real Estate is seeking an Accountant to join their team in Makkah. This full-time role involves ensuring accurate accounting practices, preparing essential financial reports, and providing support for the company's operational activities and projects. The position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience and offers a monthly salary of SAR 4,000–5,000. Key Responsibilities Prepare and review journal entries and conduct bank reconciliations. Manage monthly and annual closing processes and prepare financial reports and statements. Oversee accounts payable and receivable, including collections and payments. Monitor cash flow and assist in the preparation of budgets. Review project costs and payment certificates in alignment with contractual agreements. Prepare tax returns and ensure compliance with ZATCA requirements. Coordinate with external auditors and contribute to the improvement of accounting procedures and controls. Qualifications and Requirements Good knowledge of accounting standards and tax requirements in Saudi Arabia. Proficiency in Excel and various accounting systems. Strong analytical skills, meticulous attention to detail, and the ability to meet deadlines consistently. Experience in the real estate sector and relevant professional certifications are considered advantageous. Work Environment and Location This is a full-time position based in Makkah, Saudi Arabia. The role supports Artas Real Estate's operations across its projects in cities including Jeddah and Makkah. Compensation The successful candidate will receive a monthly salary ranging from SAR 4,000 to SAR 5,000. Application Process Interested candidates who meet the qualifications are encouraged to apply.

f3906a62fb6dd07f.company_name: شركة البابطين لصناعة البسكويت والمواد الغذائيه
f3906a62fb6dd07f.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة المساكن العصرية للمقاولات عن محاسب للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إدارة المستندات المالية، ومتابعة الإيرادات، وإعداد التقارير المحاسبية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال المحاسبة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية يتولى المحاسب مسؤولية مجموعة من المهام المالية والإدارية لضمان دقة السجلات والتقارير. تشمل هذه المهام ما يلي: إعداد وتنظيم وتوثيق مستندات الصرف، ومتابعة تدقيقها وإجازتها من الجهات الرقابية المعتمدة. متابعة تحصيل الإيرادات وتوثيقها وتحليلها بشكل دوري. تدقيق المطالبات المالية والتأكد من اكتمال شروطها القانونية والمالية. إعداد القيود المحاسبية وتسجيل العمليات المالية في السجلات المحاسبية. تدقيق حسابات البنوك وإعداد التسويات اللازمة مع كشوف المطابقة الشهرية. مراقبة النفقات الجارية والرأسمالية بما يتوافق مع الموقف المالي الشهري لبنود الموازنة. إعداد الموقف المالي والخلاصات الشهرية، بالإضافة إلى إعداد وتنظيم الحسابات الختامية السنوية. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة في مجال محاسبة النفقات والإيرادات وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة. تطوير الأساليب المحاسبية يُتوقع من المحاسب في هذا الدور أن يساهم في تطوير أساليب وإجراءات المحاسبة المتبعة في الشركة. يشمل ذلك مواكبة التطور العلمي والتقني في مجال المحاسبة لضمان تطبيق أفضل الممارسات وتحسين الكفاءة التشغيلية. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال المحاسبة. القدرة على إعداد وتنظيم المستندات المالية بدقة. معرفة جيدة بمبادئ المحاسبة وإعداد التقارير المالية. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة. سيعمل المحاسب ضمن فريق مالي لدعم العمليات المحاسبية لشركة المساكن العصرية للمقاولات. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم لهذه الفرصة في شركة المساكن العصرية للمقاولات.

f395632770fccb97.description: About the Role FNRCO is seeking a Reefer Technician to join their team in Makkah, with operations spanning Jeddah and Makkah. This full-time role requires 2-5 years of experience and focuses on the inspection, maintenance, and repair of refrigerated containers to ensure their optimal operational status. Key Responsibilities Inspect refrigerated containers during receiving, yard storage, and operational periods. Connect and disconnect reefer containers to/from the terminal power supply as per operating procedures. Monitor reefer temperature, set point, return-air temperature, supply-air temperature, alarms, and operating status. Identify and respond to reefer alarms, temperature deviations, power failures, and equipment faults. Troubleshoot refrigeration, electrical, electronic, and control-system problems. Diagnose faults involving compressors, condenser/evaporator fans, sensors, controllers, contactors, relays, evaporators, condensers, and power-supply systems. Perform preventive maintenance and corrective repairs on reefer units. Check refrigerant pressure and identify possible refrigerant leakage. Carry out electrical testing and component replacement as required. Verify reefer performance after repair before returning the unit to operational status. Record reefer inspection results, alarms, repairs, parts replaced, and unit status. Coordinate with reefer operations and yard personnel regarding container availability and access. Prioritize critical reefer faults involving temperature-sensitive cargo and immediately escalate unresolved issues. Maintain reefer maintenance tools, test equipment, and spare parts. Follow refrigerant-handling, electrical isolation, environmental, PPE, and terminal HSE procedures. Experience and Qualifications Candidates for this position should possess 2-5 years of relevant experience in reefer maintenance and repair. A strong understanding of refrigeration, electrical, and control systems is essential for effective troubleshooting and diagnostics. Work Environment and Practices The role involves working in a dynamic environment, requiring adherence to strict safety and operational protocols. The Reefer Technician will be responsible for maintaining tools and equipment, and for ensuring all work is conducted in compliance with environmental, PPE, and terminal HSE procedures. Location This full-time position is based in the Makkah region, with operational duties in both Jeddah and Makkah. Application Process FNRCO offers a competitive opportunity for qualified professionals. Salary details will be disclosed during the interview process.

f3a16fb404d76754.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة برايت روت عن أخصائي تسويق للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ومناسب للمرشحين ذوي الخبرة من 0 إلى سنة واحدة، حيث يركز على تطوير وتنفيذ وتقييم السياسات التسويقية للسلع والخدمات. الهدف من الوظيفة تتمثل المهمة الأساسية لأخصائي التسويق في تحديد الأهداف التسويقية، وتطوير الاستراتيجيات والخطط اللازمة لتحقيقها، بالإضافة إلى الإشراف على تنفيذها وتقييم فعاليتها. يشمل ذلك إجراء تحليلات للسوق والمنتجات، ووضع سياسات التسعير والترويج، وإعداد التقارير المتخصصة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تحديد الأهداف التسويقية العامة والفرعية، وتطوير السياسات والخطط والبرامج التسويقية. تحليل دورة حياة المنتج لتحديد عوامل النجاح أو الفشل التسويقي. تحليل أسعار المنافسين وتطوير سياسات التسعير التنافسية. تحديد برامج الترويج واختيار قنوات التوزيع وتقييم فعالية الحملات الإعلانية. وضع جداول زمنية لتنفيذ السياسات التسويقية ومتابعة إجراءات التنفيذ وتقييم النتائج. إجراء اختبارات للمنتجات الجديدة قبل طرحها في الأسواق باستخدام برامج حاسوبية متخصصة. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالتسويق، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال التسويق. القدرة على تحديد الأهداف التسويقية وتطوير السياسات. مهارات تحليلية قوية لتقييم أداء المنتجات والسوق. القدرة على استخدام برامج حاسوبية متخصصة في اختبارات السوق. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة، ضمن فريق عمل شركة برايت روت. الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على المقابلة والخبرة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذه الفرصة.

f3912a964b35afa2.description: About Us Moneymoon is a pioneering Fintech platform transforming short-term microlending through secure, compliant, and seamless peer-to-peer technology. We enable individuals to support one another through a one-month lending model built on transparency, safety, and trust. As we progress through the Saudi Central Bank (SAMA) Regulatory Sandbox and prepare for full licensing, strong AML controls, regulatory compliance, customer protection, and effective governance are critical to our mission. Your Role We’re looking for an AML & Compliance Specialist to support Moneymoon’s AML, regulatory compliance, monitoring, and control activities. In this role, you will help ensure that our operations, customer journeys, financing activities, policies, and internal processes remain aligned with applicable regulatory requirements, particularly those issued by the Saudi Central Bank (SAMA). You will work across both AML and Compliance, supporting customer due diligence, transaction monitoring, regulatory research, compliance testing, policy reviews, regulatory tracking, and internal reporting. This role is ideal for a fresh graduate who is highly curious, analytical, detail-oriented, and eager to build a career in compliance and financial crime within a fast-moving fintech environment. You will also be encouraged to use AI, automation, and modern productivity tools to make regulatory research, monitoring, documentation, and analysis faster, smarter, and more efficient. Your Responsibilities AML & Financial Crime • Support customer due diligence and KYC reviews to ensure required customer information and documentation are complete and accurate. • Review customer profiles and financing activities to identify unusual or potentially suspicious behavior. • Support transaction monitoring activities and review alerts generated through AML or fraud monitoring scenarios. • Assist in identifying suspicious patterns, customer behavior, transaction trends, and financial crime risks. • Support enhanced due diligence activities for higher-risk customers or cases when required. • Maintain accurate AML case records, investigation notes, evidence, and supporting documentation. • Escalate unusual or suspicious activities to the relevant Compliance and AML stakeholders. • Support the review and periodic improvement of AML monitoring scenarios and internal controls. • Assist with AML-related reporting, trackers, dashboards, and regulatory documentation. • Support internal reviews relating to potential AML breaches or control gaps. Regulatory Compliance • Monitor SAMA circulars, regulatory updates, guidance, and applicable regulatory requirements. • Support regulatory research and translate applicable requirements into clear internal actions. • Assist in maintaining Moneymoon’s regulatory obligations tracker and follow up on implementation across relevant teams. • Support the development, review, and maintenance of compliance policies, procedures, standards, and internal controls. • Perform compliance monitoring and testing activities to assess adherence to regulatory requirements and internal policies. • Support compliance risk assessments and help identify control gaps, regulatory risks, and required remediation actions. • Review business processes, customer journeys, products, initiatives, and internal practices from a compliance perspective. • Document compliance observations, recommendations, and action items and follow up on agreed remediation. • Support investigations into potential regulatory breaches, policy violations, and compliance concerns. • Maintain accurate compliance registers, trackers, records, and supporting evidence. • Support the preparation of compliance reports, regulatory updates, monitoring results, and management materials. • Assist with regulatory examinations, internal audits, and independent compliance reviews by preparing evidence and supporting documentation. • Support compliance training and awareness activities across the company. • Work closely with Operations, Risk, Cybersecurity, Finance, Product, Technology, Data & AI, and other teams to strengthen regulatory and AML controls. AI, Automation & Process Improvement • Use AI tools and automation to support regulatory research, document reviews, control testing, reporting, and compliance monitoring. • Explore ways to simplify repetitive AML and compliance tasks through automation and smarter workflows. • Use AI-assisted analysis to help identify patterns, inconsistencies, regulatory gaps, and potential risk areas. • Support the development of more efficient compliance trackers, dashboards, templates, and monitoring processes. • Stay up to date with developments in RegTech, AI-enabled compliance, AML technology, and financial crime prevention. Your Expertise • Bachelor’s degree in Law, Finance, Business Administration, Accounting, Risk Management, Compliance, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or a related field. • Fresh graduates are welcome to apply. • Previous COOP or internship experience is highly preferred, especially within a fintech, startup, banking, financial services, compliance, AML, risk, audit, or regulatory environment. • Exposure to a fast-paced startup or fintech environment is considered a strong advantage. • Interest in AML, regulatory compliance, financial crime, fintech regulation, and SAMA requirements. • Strong analytical skills and excellent attention to detail. • Ability to read regulations, policies, and procedures and translate them into practical actions. • Strong problem-solving mindset and ability to identify gaps or inconsistencies. • Strong written and verbal communication skills. • Good organizational and time-management skills. • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a fast-moving environment. • Good knowledge of Microsoft Excel is preferred. • Familiarity with AI tools, automation, data analysis tools, or modern productivity platforms is highly preferred. • Knowledge of SQL, Python, BI tools, or workflow automation tools is a plus. • Strong sense of ownership, integrity, confidentiality, and professional judgment. • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams. • Fluency in Arabic and English. What We’re Looking For You are curious and naturally interested in understanding how regulations work, why controls exist, and how risks can be prevented before they become problems. You are comfortable reading regulations, reviewing details, asking questions, and challenging inconsistencies when something does not make sense. You are also highly interested in AI and technology and actively look for ways to use them to work faster, reduce manual effort, and improve the quality of compliance and AML activities. You do not need years of experience, but you do need a strong willingness to learn, take ownership, and grow quickly. You enjoy working in a startup environment where priorities move fast, responsibilities are broad, and people are expected to contribute beyond the boundaries of their job title. Most importantly, you are excited to build your career in AML, regulatory compliance, fintech risk, and AI-enabled compliance while helping Moneymoon build a safe, trusted, and regulator-ready financial platform.

f34f8d20506c8be7.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مجمع سينان لطب الأسنان عن محاسب للانضمام إلى فريقه في بريدة، القصيم. يتولى المحاسب مسؤولية إعداد وتنظيم المستندات المالية، ومتابعة الإيرادات، وتسجيل العمليات المحاسبية، بالإضافة إلى إعداد التقارير المالية اللازمة. هذا الدور متاح بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تدقيق المطالبات المالية والتأكد من استيفائها للشروط القانونية والمالية. إعداد وتنظيم وتوثيق مستندات الصرف ومتابعة تدقيقها وإجازتها من الجهات الرقابية المعتمدة. مراقبة النفقات الجارية والرأسمالية بناءً على الموقف المالي الشهري لبنود الموازنة. إعداد الموقف المالي والخلاصات الشهرية، بالإضافة إلى إعداد وتنظيم الحسابات الختامية السنوية. إعداد القيود المحاسبية وتسجيل العمليات المالية في السجلات. تدقيق حسابات البنوك وإعداد التسويات اللازمة مع كشوف المطابقة الشهرية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات المحاسبة ومواكبة التطور العلمي والتقني في هذا المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالنفقات والإيرادات وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المحاسبة. القدرة على إعداد وتنظيم مستندات الصرف ومتابعة تحصيل الإيرادات. معرفة بإعداد القيود المحاسبية وتسجيل العمليات المالية. القدرة على تدقيق حسابات البنوك وإعداد التسويات اللازمة. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تحليلية قوية لتوثيق وتحليل الإيرادات والنفقات. الدقة والاهتمام بالتفاصيل في إعداد التقارير والوثائق المالية. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق والتواصل الفعال. مهارات تنظيمية عالية لحفظ المستندات والتقارير. بيئة العمل يعمل المحاسب في مجمع سينان لطب الأسنان بمدينة بريدة، القصيم، ضمن بيئة عمل احترافية تدعم النمو والتطور المهني. الوظيفة بدوام كامل، وتقدم فرصة للمساهمة في إدارة العمليات المالية للمجمع. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة الشخصية.

f36a031bb3a19541.description: About the Role Baja is seeking a Hygiene Supervisor to lead the implementation and monitoring of hygiene and sanitation standards across its coffee, seed, and nut processing operations, as well as employee accommodation and staff catering facilities. This full-time position is based in Hawtat Sudair, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. The role ensures compliance with SFDA, ISO 22000, HACCP, GMP, PRPs/OPRPs, Halal, and applicable labor-housing and welfare standards. Key Responsibilities Ensure full implementation and monitoring of cleaning and sanitation schedules across all processing areas for coffee, seeds, and nuts, verifying the effectiveness of GMP, PRP, and OPRP procedures. Manage and monitor the pest control program across production, warehousing, staff accommodation, and catering areas, including reviewing contractor reports and escalating recurring issues. Conduct routine hygiene inspections of employee housing, ensuring cleanliness, proper waste management, and pest-free conditions in line with company welfare standards and regulations. Oversee hygiene and food safety practices in staff catering operations, including food storage, preparation, temperature control, and cleanliness of premises and equipment. Monitor CCP/OPRP hygiene checkpoints, coordinate swab and water testing, and review records, escalating deviations immediately. Plan and execute routine food safety and hygiene inspections, GMP walkthroughs, accommodation inspections, catering audits, and periodic mock recalls. Maintain readiness for SFDA and certification body audits, ensuring compliance with regulatory updates affecting food safety and worker housing standards. Train production, catering, and accommodation staff on hygiene practices, CCPs, allergens, traceability, and documentation, leading daily pre-shift GMP briefings. Respond to food safety, hygiene, or sanitation incidents, conduct root cause analysis (RCA), and lead CAPA implementation and tracking. Verify hygiene compliance of catering service providers and raw material handling practices, participating in supplier/vendor hygiene evaluations. Enforce compliance with established hygiene, food safety, and accommodation welfare policies across all shifts and areas, escalating policy breaches to the Quality Manager. Maintain dashboards and KPIs covering hygiene scores, pest control trends, catering audit results, accommodation inspection findings, non-conformance trends, and training coverage. Leadership and Team Supervision This role involves supervising and coaching hygiene, sanitation, and camp-hygiene staff. The supervisor will be responsible for proactive issue identification and resolution across plant, kitchen, and accommodation areas, requiring strong cross-functional coordination with Production, Quality, HR/Admin, and catering vendors. A continuous improvement mindset and discretion in matters affecting employee welfare are essential. Qualifications and Requirements 2-5 years of experience in hygiene supervision or a related field. Demonstrated ability to implement and enforce hygiene SOPs across production, accommodation, and catering areas. Experience with CCP, sanitation, traceability, allergen control, pest control, and Halal assurance procedures. Familiarity with SFDA, ISO 22000, GMP, and applicable labor-housing requirements. Ability to conduct audits and inspections, reviewing the effectiveness of procedures and suggesting updates. Work Environment This is a full-time position located in Hawtat Sudair, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role operates within a dynamic environment that includes food processing facilities, staff accommodation, and catering operations, requiring a calm and structured response under pressure.

f3bd1355719948d0.description: About the Role Alkhorayef Industries Company is seeking a Quality Assurance Specialist to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is essential for maintaining and enhancing the company's quality management systems and operational standards. The specialist will be responsible for ensuring adherence to international quality standards and driving continuous improvement across various functions. Quality Management and Control Review internal Quality Management Systems (QMS) against international standards, identify discrepancies, and propose necessary amendments to align internal processes with adopted standards. Amend QMS activities, processes, and documents to address identified variations and integrate proposed changes into AIC’s Quality Control activities. Ensure effective communication and consistent adherence to approved amendments across all AIC functions. Inspection, Testing, and Corrective Actions Conduct semi-annual reviews of international inspection standards to ensure their adoption in inspection processes. Amend inspection and testing processes and related documents for review and approval by the Quality Manager. Communicate and train the quality team on inspection and testing amendments to ensure understanding and application of approved practices. Review and validate rejection notes from Quality Inspectors, discuss issues with the Engineering team, and issue final actions to relevant departments. Ensure rejected or conceded materials and products are not released without proper justifications and approvals from Quality and Production Managers. Develop and implement corrective-preventative action plans, following up with concerned parties across AIC. Review and validate Reject Notes and Management Review Meeting (MRM) findings post-survey to conduct root-cause analysis and recommend actions to reduce future production rejections. Warranty Case Management Address received warranty claims by assigning quality team members or conducting customer site visits to assess cases and determine next steps. Prepare customer complaint documents, including root-cause analysis and corrective-preventative actions to prevent recurrence. Ensure reports and documents are communicated to the Production Manager for review, validation, and co-approval. Negotiate and agree on warranty case acceptance or rejection with the Production Manager, escalating unresolved cases to the General Manager. Customer and Supplier Relations Oversee the annual creation of customer engagement surveys, secure consensus from department managers, and present for General Manager approval. Collaborate with the After Sales Manager to identify suitable survey types and communication methods for customer feedback. Follow up with the After Sales Manager to collect, collate, report, and analyze customer satisfaction survey results. Develop annual supplier evaluation documents and scorecards, discussing recommendations and action plans with the Purchasing team. Present recommendations at the Management Review Meeting (MRM) based on customer engagement survey analysis and supplier evaluation scores. Communicate supplier scores to the Purchasing Manager for supplier blocking through Finance, as needed. Policy Implementation and Continuous Improvement Ensure control of all procedures and documents through established document control processes to track amendments. Review and approve prepared forms and documents, ensuring control numbers and dates are issued according to policies. Distribute approved documents and forms across AIC functions and ensure the removal of outdated documents in coordination with department managers. Implement approved Quality policies, processes, and procedures, providing instructions to subordinates and monitoring adherence. Contribute to identifying opportunities for continuous improvement in systems, processes, and practices, focusing on leading practices, business process enhancement, cost reduction, and productivity. Support daily activity monitoring to ensure compliance with stipulated policies and procedures. Qualifications and Experience 0-1 year of relevant experience.

Ensuring the achievement of contractual maintenance KPIs, including system availability, incident response and repair times, preventive maintenance completion, and reduction of recurring incidents. Ensuring effective management of site resources, including spare parts, tools, equipment, repairs, logistics, and supplies. f312f7ea380db2af.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة مركز مهارات التفوق للرعاية النهارية عن أخصائي علاج وظيفي للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على مساعدة المرضى في تحسين قدراتهم على أداء مهام الحياة اليومية والعمل، بالإضافة إلى تعليم ذوي الإعاقات كيفية التكيف مع بيئتهم. الغرض من الوظيفة يهدف أخصائي العلاج الوظيفي إلى دعم المرضى في استعادة أو تطوير المهارات اللازمة للاستقلالية في الأنشطة اليومية. يشمل ذلك التدريب على استخدام المعدات التكيفية وتطوير استراتيجيات لتحسين الوظائف الحركية والتنسيق، مع مواكبة أحدث التطورات في مجال العلاج الوظيفي. المسؤوليات الرئيسية مساعدة المرضى في تحسين قدراتهم على تنفيذ مهام الحياة اليومية والعمل. تدريب المرضى على أداء الأنشطة المتعلقة برعاية الاحتياجات اليومية، مثل ارتداء الملابس والطهي وتناول الطعام. استخدام التمارين البدنية لزيادة القوة واستعادة البراعة الجسدية والتغلب على مشاكل التنسيق الحركي. تعليم ذوي الإعاقات الدائمة كيفية استخدام معدات التكيف، بما في ذلك الكراسي المتحركة والجبائر والأدوات الخاصة المساعدة في تناول الطعام وارتداء الملابس. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات في مجال العلاج الوظيفي. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال العلاج الوظيفي. القدرة على تطبيق أساليب العلاج الوظيفي المختلفة بفعالية. مهارات تواصل ممتازة للتعامل مع المرضى وذويهم. بيئة العمل يعمل أخصائي العلاج الوظيفي ضمن بيئة رعاية نهارية داعمة في جدة، مكة المكرمة، حيث يتاح له الفرصة للمساهمة بشكل مباشر في تحسين جودة حياة المرضى. معلومات إضافية هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتوفر فرصة للمتخصصين الجدد أو ذوي الخبرة المحدودة لتطوير مهاراتهم في مجال حيوي ومؤثر. الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على المقابلة والمؤهلات.

f352ec8d7b879e54.description: About My Clinic KSA My Clinic KSA, established in 2017, is a leading multispecialty outpatient care provider in Saudi Arabia. The organization focuses on helping individuals achieve longer, healthier, and happier lives through a commitment to care, collaboration, ambition, and responsibility. My Clinic KSA is expanding its team in Makkah and Jeddah. The Role of Health Educator My Clinic KSA is seeking a Health Educator to provide clinical advice and education to individuals living with, or at risk of developing, diabetes. This full-time role involves supporting patients in Makkah and Jeddah with necessary lifestyle changes, including nutrition, medication management, physical activity, and glucose testing, to help them manage their condition effectively. Key Responsibilities Assist individuals with diabetes, their families, and caregivers in gaining the knowledge, skills, motivation, and confidence to manage their condition. Educate patients on diabetes, including potential complications and its relation to other health conditions. Offer advice and support regarding lifestyle changes that contribute to diabetes management. Provide guidance on medication management safety, covering actions, timing, side effects, and the correct use of insulin therapy, including injection techniques and site checking. Educate on the self-monitoring of blood glucose levels, including proper technique and interpretation of results. Support goal setting and the implementation of strategies to achieve health objectives. Encourage collaboration among other healthcare providers involved in the diabetes care team, such as general practitioners, specialist medical practitioners (endocrinologists/diabetologists), dietitians, physiotherapists, podiatrists, optometrists, and pharmacists. Introduce, educate on, demonstrate, and install Continuous Glucose Monitoring (CGM) devices and other devices like insulin pumps for patients on multiple daily insulin injections, aiming for significant improvement in quality of life. Maintain knowledge of the latest information and technology in the field of diabetes. Monitor and document patient progress. Perform other professional duties as assigned. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of relevant experience in health education, particularly with diabetes management. Demonstrated ability to provide clinical advice and education on lifestyle changes. Proficiency in educating patients on medication management and glucose monitoring. Experience with Continuous Glucose Monitoring devices and insulin pumps is preferred. Work Location This full-time position is based in the cities of Jeddah and Makkah, within the Makkah region of Saudi Arabia. Application Process Candidates who meet the specified qualifications and are interested in contributing to My Clinic KSA's mission are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

f394a3689f9bd439.description: About the Role Edition is seeking an Assistant Restaurant Manager to join their team in the Red Sea region. This full-time position requires 5-10 years of experience and involves overseeing daily restaurant operations to ensure optimal service and guest satisfaction. The Assistant Restaurant Manager will play a key role in staff management, operational efficiency, and maintaining high standards of quality and safety. Key Responsibilities Ensure staff collaboration for optimum service delivery and guest needs fulfillment. Inspect staff grooming and attire, addressing any deficiencies promptly. Execute opening and closing duties, including setting up supplies, cleaning, and securing premises. Monitor storage areas for organization, adherence to FIFO principles, and cleanliness. Conduct scheduled inventories, stock management, and requisition necessary supplies. Oversee dining rooms to ensure seating availability, service quality, guest safety, and well-being. Submit work orders for maintenance and repairs as needed. Leadership and Team Development Support management in hiring, training, scheduling, evaluating, counseling, disciplining, motivating, and coaching employees. Serve as a role model and initial contact for the Guarantee of Fair Treatment/Open Door Policy process. Foster positive working relationships and support team goals, actively listening and responding to employee concerns. Operational Standards and Compliance Adhere to all company, safety, and security policies and procedures. Report accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to management and complete required safety training and certifications. Ensure professional appearance, maintain confidentiality of proprietary information, and protect company assets. Communicate professionally and clearly with all individuals. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards. Identify, recommend, develop, and implement improvements for organizational efficiency, productivity, quality, safety, and cost-savings. Physical Requirements Ability to read and visually verify information in various formats. Capability to visually inspect tools, equipment, or machines for defects. Capacity to stand, sit, or walk for extended periods or an entire work shift. Ability to move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing up to 50 pounds without assistance. Proficiency in grasping, turning, and manipulating objects requiring fine motor skills and hand-eye coordination. Ability to navigate narrow, confined, or elevated spaces, and move up and down stairs and/or service ramps. Capability to reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. f3ae6f030b5fc1af.description: About the Role: Cook I Pastry Le Méridien Hotels & Resorts is seeking a Cook I Pastry to join their team in Al Khobar, Eastern region. This full-time role involves preparing a variety of baked goods and pastries, ensuring adherence to quality standards and food safety protocols. Review production sheets to understand daily baked goods requirements. Cook and prepare food items according to established recipes, quality, and presentation standards. Maintain kitchen logs to ensure compliance with food safety programs. Inform the Chef of excess food items for daily specials planning. Utilize baking and measuring tools, equipment, and appliances safely and appropriately. Adhere to and ensure compliance with food safety handling policies and personal hygiene procedures. Monitor and ensure correct temperatures of kitchen appliances and food, reporting any issues to management. Oversee the quality of prepared food and portion sizes throughout the shift. Operational Support and Compliance Assist management with hiring, training, scheduling, evaluating, counseling, disciplining, motivating, and coaching employees. f3c2c3eb200ca916.company_name: KAUST (King Abdullah University of Science and Technology)
f3c2c3eb200ca916.description: About the Role KAUST (King Abdullah University of Science and Technology) is undertaking a Cybersecurity Transformation Program focused on securing cloud and hybrid environments across its multi-cloud infrastructure. This full-time role for a Cloud Security Engineering Lead, based in Thuwal, Makkah, involves designing, implementing, and assuring secure cloud and hybrid environments. The position requires 5-10 years of experience and combines solution architecture with direct technical execution across various security domains. Role Overview The Cloud Security Engineering Lead will translate security requirements into deployable technical controls, lead complex implementation activities, and resolve cross-platform dependencies. This role ensures solutions are operationally supportable and measurable, working across multiple portfolio initiatives. Key projects include Microsoft 365 A5, Enterprise IAM, cloud security posture improvement, security operations integration, network security, and cyber exposure reduction. The incumbent is expected to remain hands-on in design, configuration, integration, troubleshooting, testing, remediation, and knowledge transfer, while providing technical direction to partners and internal teams. Key Responsibilities Own cloud security architecture and engineering activities from design through implementation, stabilization, and operational handover within the Cybersecurity Transformation Program. Assess Azure, Microsoft 365, hybrid, and multi-cloud environments to identify security gaps and opportunities for control improvement. Design and implement secure cloud architectures aligned with KAUST security principles, enterprise architecture standards, and Zero Trust objectives. Provide hands-on engineering across Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, Privileged Identity Management, Identity Protection, MFA, passwordless controls, Intune, Defender XDR, Defender for Cloud, Microsoft Sentinel, and Microsoft Purview. Engineer and improve cloud security posture management, workload protection, attack-path reduction, logging, monitoring, and security configuration across IaaS, PaaS, SaaS, endpoint, and identity environments. Design and implement integrations between cloud platforms and Security Operations, including SIEM/SOAR telemetry, detection use cases, KQL analytics, and incident automation. Apply Zero Trust principles across identity, privileged access, endpoints, applications, network access, collaboration, and data. Develop secure connectivity and access patterns for cloud and hybrid environments, collaborating with network security teams. Lead technical design decisions, configuration reviews, proof-of-concept activities, testing, troubleshooting, and remediation for assigned initiatives. Review and challenge designs proposed by vendors and partners to ensure alignment with KAUST standards. Lead or support migration and modernization activities from legacy security platforms to cloud-native capabilities. Manage technical dependencies with Enterprise IAM, Network Security, Cyber Exposure Reduction, Security Operations, and other teams. Contribute technical leadership to the Microsoft 365 A5 project, including architecture, security configuration, and operational integration. Define technical acceptance criteria, validation evidence, security baselines, and production-readiness requirements. Proactively identify and resolve architecture risks, misconfigurations, security gaps, and implementation blockers. Produce high-quality as-built designs, configuration standards, engineering documentation, and knowledge-transfer materials. Upskill internal technical teams through pairing, technical walkthroughs, and structured knowledge transfer. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Security, Information Technology, Engineering, or a closely related discipline. Substantial equivalent professional experience may be considered. Advanced Microsoft certifications in Azure architecture, security, identity, Microsoft 365 security, or security operations are strongly preferred. Relevant cloud or cybersecurity certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, GIAC cloud security, Microsoft Security certifications, or Google/AWS security certifications are advantageous. Certifications should support demonstrable hands-on enterprise cloud security engineering and implementation experience. Required Skills Deep hands-on cloud security engineering expertise across Microsoft Azure and Microsoft 365, with the ability to move between architecture, configuration, integration, troubleshooting, and operationalization. Strong knowledge of Microsoft security technologies including Entra ID, Conditional Access, PIM, Identity Protection, Defender XDR, Defender for Cloud, Intune, Microsoft Sentinel, and Microsoft Purview. Strong understanding of cloud security architecture across identity, network, endpoint, workloads, applications, data, logging, monitoring, and security operations. Practical experience designing and implementing Zero Trust architectures and identity-centric security controls in enterprise environments. Strong understanding of SIEM/SOAR, detection engineering, KQL or comparable query languages, security telemetry onboarding, incident automation, and SOC integration. Experience with cloud security posture management, workload hardening, attack-path analysis, secure configuration baselines, and remediation across IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS. Ability to design secure hybrid and multi-cloud integrations, including federation, SSO, network connectivity, logging, and security control alignment. Strong technical governance and engineering judgment, including the ability to challenge vendor designs and translate security requirements into practical implementation decisions. Ability to lead multidisciplinary technical teams and delivery partners while maintaining hands-on engagement in critical technical work. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical risks, architecture decisions, and delivery implications to both technical and senior stakeholders. Evidence-led and outcome-oriented approach. Work Environment This full-time position is based in Thuwal, Makkah, within KAUST's dynamic environment, focusing on modern security architectures and sustainable operational handover. The role involves close collaboration with internal teams and delivery partners to modernize security operations, cloud security posture, identity, and network security.

f3cb14af831ba57b.description: About Parfum Christian Dior Parfum Christian Dior maintains high standards of excellence across all aspects of its operations, from product offerings to customer experience. The company is seeking a Stock Keeper to join its team in Makkah or Jeddah, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time position requiring 0-1 years of experience. Role Summary The Stock Keeper is responsible for ensuring accurate stock management and supporting the smooth daily operations of the boutique. This role involves managing all aspects of boutique stock, including receiving, storage, replenishment, transfers, and inventory control, while upholding Dior's standards. Key Responsibilities Receive and verify deliveries against delivery notes, reporting any discrepancies or damaged products. Organize stock according to the First-In, First-Out (FIFO) principle. Monitor stock levels and identify replenishment needs. Manage returns of damaged or End-of-Life (EOL) products to the warehouse. Verify product prices and labels. Coordinate stock transfers between boutiques. Support urgent home delivery orders as required. Monitor expiration dates for products, testers, Gifts With Purchase (GWPs), and samples. Maintain delivery claims and stock trackers. Conduct cycle counts and assist with annual stock counts. Investigate and escalate stock discrepancies, negative stock, or suspected theft. Ensure used testers are properly segregated for warehouse return. Maintain accurate Point of Sale Material (POSM) and merchandise trackers. Manage the movement and storage of POSM and merchandise. Maintain a clean, organized, and secure stockroom. Adhere to Dior and company procedures and internal controls. Collaborate with the Boutique, Warehouse, Logistics, and other relevant teams. Provide support to the boutique during events, inventory counts, and urgent business needs. Demonstrate professionalism, respect, and commitment to Dior values consistently. Qualifications and Experience Previous experience in stock management, inventory, logistics, or retail operations. Experience in the luxury and beauty sectors is an advantage. Good knowledge of MS Office, particularly Excel. Strong communication and teamwork skills. Ability to manage multiple tasks effectively in a fast-paced environment. Strong attention to detail and organizational skills. Fluency in both Arabic and English.

f33193fd400f7c60.description: About PepsiCo PepsiCo is a global leader in beverages and convenient foods, with products enjoyed by consumers over one billion times daily across more than 200 countries and territories. In 2021, PepsiCo generated over $79 billion in net revenue, driven by a portfolio that includes iconic brands such as LAY’S®, DORITOS®, CHEETOS®, GATORADE®, PEPSI®, and QUAKER®. The company's vision is to achieve global leadership by Winning with PepsiCo Positive (pep+), a strategic transformation focused on sustainability and human capital to create value and growth within planetary boundaries. The Role of Salesman This full-time Salesman position is based in the Eastern region of Saudi Arabia. As part of the sales team, the primary objective is to maximize sales volume, minimize product waste, achieve distribution targets, implement merchandising standards, and ensure high levels of customer service. The role also involves collecting accounts receivable and providing the supervisor with market information to identify sales opportunities. Adherence to operating procedures is essential to maintain consistent standards across KSA. Key Responsibilities Sell the full range of products to an agreed list of customers, with performance measured against sales targets and waste levels kept below the agreed target. Provide customer service as approved by the supervisor, maintaining call frequency and adhering to the daily route plan. Conduct daily and weekly vehicle checks, ensuring the sales vehicle is clean and roadworthy, and reporting any defects or damage promptly. Agree daily order requirements for the next selling period with the supervisor. Maintain individual customer stock levels to agreed requirements to minimize out-of-stock situations. Implement agreed in-store merchandising standards as communicated by the supervisor, coordinating with company merchandisers where applicable. Advise the supervisor of any relevant competitor activity in the assigned area during daily debriefing sessions. Perform daily reconciliation of all cheques, cash, and credit sales, ensuring zero stock and cash shortages. Maintain a neat and presentable appearance at all times. Adhere to high driving standards and obey all driving regulations. Performance Measurement Performance in this role will be measured against specific Key Performance Indicators (KPIs). Consistent failure to meet these targets may lead to disciplinary action. Daily/weekly sales versus planned sales. Daily positive calls versus plan. Daily call sequence versus plan. Stales versus target. Zero cash and stock shortages. Professional Development The Salesman will be required to attend training courses designed to enhance professionalism and customer service skills. Daily debriefing sessions with the supervisor are also a mandatory part of the role. Work Environment PepsiCo fosters a dynamic and collaborative culture where new ideas are embraced. The company is committed to creating a diverse, equitable, and inclusive space where every associate's voice is valued. Employees are encouraged to learn more about the company culture and life at PepsiCo through available resources.

f3542cc164344a80.description: About the Company Al-Ayuni Investment and Contracting Company is a prominent firm based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The company specializes in major construction and infrastructure projects across the region. The Role of Senior Planning Engineer We are seeking a Senior Planning Engineer to join our ePMO team in Riyadh. This full-time position is responsible for developing, monitoring, and controlling project schedules for significant construction and infrastructure initiatives. The role ensures that all planning activities align with contractual requirements, execution strategies, and company objectives, while also providing mentorship to junior planners and delivering accurate reports and forecasts to management. Key Responsibilities Develop baseline schedules using Primavera P6 and secure client approvals. Monitor project progress, identify potential delays, and propose effective recovery actions. Perform comprehensive delay impact analyses and support Extension of Time (EOT) claims. Coordinate closely with project, procurement, and technical teams to ensure smooth project execution. Prepare and present detailed dashboards and reports utilizing Excel and Power BI. Track manpower, equipment, and productivity performance against established baselines. Required Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of experience in project planning and controls, preferably within major construction and infrastructure projects. Demonstrated expertise in developing, monitoring, and controlling project schedules. Proficiency in Primavera P6 and strong analytical skills for delay impact analysis. Skills and Attributes Strong communication and coordination skills for effective team collaboration. Ability to prepare and present clear, accurate reports and forecasts. Mentorship capabilities to guide junior planning engineers. Proficiency in Excel and Power BI for data visualization and reporting. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, within a dynamic ePMO team focused on large-scale construction and infrastructure projects.

f362fb37dc2019fd.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة قناص العربية المحدودة عن أخصائي تغذية للانضمام إلى فريقها في منطقة عسير، بمدينة احد رفيده. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تطوير برامج التغذية والحمية الغذائية للمرضى والأصحاء، بالإضافة إلى إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتعلقة بهذا المجال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة القيم الغذائية والسعرات الحرارية لمختلف أنواع الأغذية وتقدير احتياجات الأفراد من السعرات الحرارية. تحليل برامج الحمية الغذائية المتنوعة واختيار أو إعداد برامج حمية مخصصة للأفراد الأصحاء بناءً على احتياجاتهم الغذائية والحرارية. تطوير برامج تغذية للمرضى داخل المستشفيات، مع الأخذ في الاعتبار توصيات الطبيب المعالج والاحتياجات الغذائية الخاصة بالمرضى. المساهمة في تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة أحدث التطورات في مجال التغذية. إعداد وتوثيق التقارير والوثائق المتعلقة بالتغذية وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة، بما يتوافق مع السياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. ضمان تطبيق مبادئ وقواعد السلامة العامة خلال تنفيذ جميع أعمال التغذية. المؤهلات والخبرة المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال التغذية. القدرة على تحليل البيانات الغذائية وتقدير الاحتياجات الفردية. مهارات جيدة في إعداد التقارير والوثائق. نوع العمل هذا الدور متاح بنظام الدوام الكامل. المنطقة والمدينة يقع مقر العمل في عسير، احد رفيده. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.

f366e210cb9919a8.job_title: Field Service Supervisor Services (Saudi National Only)
f366e210cb9919a8.description: About the Role Honeywell Technologies is seeking a Field Service Supervisor Services to lead a team of service technicians in Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is specifically for Saudi Nationals and involves overseeing Facilities Management Contracts or large service sites. The supervisor will ensure contractual requirements are met and customer expectations are exceeded, while also contributing individually to chargeable work. Role Purpose and Objectives The primary purpose of this position is to lead a service team, developing their skills and management discipline to deliver services efficiently and within planned gross margins. The Field Service Supervisor will leverage Honeywell Building Solutions (HBS) tools, processes, and best practices to achieve the team's financial and productivity metrics, maintaining a 100% job chargeable contribution. Key Responsibilities Maintain acceptable levels of customer satisfaction and resolve any related issues. Review Voice of Customer (VOC) feedback and implement proactive actions. Identify opportunities for system upgrades, spot service needs, maintenance contract additions, and other sales leads, both individually and with the assigned team. Manage the service team's financial performance, monitoring monthly performance and reviewing available-to-spend versus actuals for contracts. Continuously improve service operational metrics. Ensure the availability of necessary tools, equipment, and materials, while maintaining and controlling inventory levels. Support the implementation and compliance of productivity-enhancing processes related to service delivery within the scope of responsibility. Lead and manage the service team in adopting, implementing, and complying with HBS Global and EMEAI policies, processes, procedures, service tools, and business best practices. Set and implement quality standards (*, quality processes, service manuals, hour reporting) and ensure the service team meets performance expectations. f394b499492ee0fb.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة أصايل التمنيه لخدمات الاعاشة عن محاسب للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إدارة العمليات المالية، بدءًا من إعداد المستندات وحتى إعداد التقارير النهائية، مع ضمان الدقة والالتزام بالمعايير المحاسبية. هذه فرصة مثالية للمرشحين الذين يتمتعون بخبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال المحاسبة. الهدف من الوظيفة يتولى المحاسب مسؤولية إعداد وتنظيم مستندات الصرف، ومتابعة تحصيل الإيرادات وتوثيقها وتحليلها. يشمل الدور أيضًا إعداد القيود المحاسبية وتسجيل العمليات المالية في السجلات، بالإضافة إلى تدقيق حسابات البنوك وإعداد التسويات اللازمة. كما يساهم المحاسب في إعداد وحفظ التقارير والوثائق المتعلقة بالنفقات والإيرادات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تدقيق المطالبات المالية والتأكد من استيفائها للشروط القانونية والمالية. إعداد وتنظيم وتوثيق مستندات الصرف، ومتابعة تدقيقها وإجازتها من الجهات الرقابية المعتمدة. مراقبة النفقات الجارية والرأسمالية بناءً على الموقف المالي الشهري لبنود الموازنة. إعداد الموقف المالي والخلاصات الشهرية، بالإضافة إلى إعداد وتنظيم الحسابات الختامية السنوية. إعداد القيود المحاسبية وتسجيل العمليات المالية في السجلات، وتدقيق حسابات البنوك وإعداد التسويات اللازمة مع كشوف المطابقة الشهرية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات المحاسبة ومواكبة التطور العلمي والتقني في هذا المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة في مجال محاسبة النفقات والإيرادات وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة لذلك. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال المحاسبة. القدرة على إعداد وتنظيم المستندات المالية بدقة. معرفة جيدة بمبادئ المحاسبة وإعداد القيود المحاسبية. مهارات تحليلية لتوثيق وتحليل الإيرادات. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق عمل شركة أصايل التمنيه لخدمات الاعاشة في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة. يتطلب الدور الالتزام بالعمل المكتبي والتعاون مع الزملاء لضمان سير العمليات المالية بسلاسة وفعالية. التقديم ندعو المرشحين المهتمين والذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذه الوظيفة. سيتم التواصل مع المرشحين المؤهلين لمناقشة تفاصيل الدور والراتب.
